name: qc_thresholds
title: QC thresholds by application
description: Quality thresholds that workbench applications and reviews apply, with the controlled document that sets each one. Superseded rows are kept for audit; filter on status effective for current rules.

column_notes.specimen: Library or specimen role the rule applies to.

name: assay_metrics
title: In-house assay metric distributions
description: Fifth percentile, median and 95th percentile of library quality metrics measured by the core. Use them to judge whether a library is typical; they are not pass or fail thresholds.

name: gene_panels
title: Germline panel genes
description: Genes on the predisposition and extended germline panels, with inheritance and the SOP-GERM-001 version that added each gene. The extended panel includes every predisposition gene.

column_notes.inheritance: AD autosomal dominant, AR autosomal recessive.

name: fusion_targets
title: Curated fusion targets
description: Recurrent pediatric fusions that rna-fusion flags when found.

name: job_error_codes
title: Workbench job log codes
description: Codes that workbench jobs write to their logs, the job state they imply and what to do.

name: reference_resources
title: Reference data in use
description: Versions of reference genomes, annotations and variant resources used by Autopipe and the workbench.

name: ensembl_id_prefixes
title: Ensembl and GENCODE ID prefixes
description: Stable identifier prefixes and the feature type each one names.

name: assay_contacts
title: Points of contact by assay
description: Team, responsible role and chat channel for each assay platform. Roles, not named people, are listed so the table survives staff changes.
